annotations.title: How capital reaches this institution, and where it goes next

description: Published capital flow paths through one institution: which allocators back this manager and through which fund, which lenders finance this sponsor's borrowers and on what facilities, which properties sit under this real estate manager where a binding is validated. Each path names every hop with its graph, id, type and role, the amount where one is disclosed, the as-of date, the bases the hops rest on and a confidence. Paths are built only from identity-grade or measured links; a candidate link is labelled and carries a confidence below 0.5. NOT_COVERED means the path layer has not computed this, never that no relationship exists.

dfx_id.description: A DFX id: dfx:fo:<uuid> (family office graph), dfx:isi:<uuid> (sponsor graph), dfx:vc:<uuid> (venture graph), dfx:pe:<uuid> (private equity graph), dfx:ria:<uuid> (registered investment adviser graph), dfx:al:<uuid> (allocator graph), dfx:pc:<uuid> (private credit graph), dfx:ref:<uuid> (real estate fund graph), or a bare real estate UUID.

kind.description: One path kind as the summary names it (for example ALLOCATOR_TO_PE_FUND_TO_MANAGER).
